Outcome: DL6 who-did-what in recurring scenes (was roadmap M4), as the hard test of DL2 + DL3 on a bounded set of recurring scenes where scene labels cannot make the distinction.
Exit: on fresh examples, share of participant-action pairs judged correct, against the scene-only baseline. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md#dl6-who-did-what-in-recurring-scenes.
